evaluation_notes.rule_log_loss: Uses rule_score/100 as an uncalibrated probability proxy.
evaluation_notes.split: Stratified 70/30 row split, not a passenger-held-out split.
evaluation_notes.synthetic: Simulated distances [0,15) km; simulated speeds [20,70) km/h plus [0,5) minutes delay; available seats assumed. Includes zero-score examples. Labels are simulated from a logistic formula, not real passenger decisions. Synthetic metrics do not establish real-world superiority.

rule_score_definition: Application score components, 20-point preference penalty, clamping and one-decimal rounding; excludes search filtering and ranking tie-breakers. Feedback mode uses recorded rule_score.
